messages:
Alex Chen: Quick FYI 10:12 UTC there was a surge of WS reconnects in eu-west-1, looks correlated with an outbound proxy change. reconnects ~2.8x baseline. Anyone tracking?
Priya Nair: Saw it in the dashboard. p90 websocket open/close increased, but console shows no increase in backend error rates. panels: https://console.internal/d/streams/reconnects (internal)
Jamal Ortiz: Logs show a recurring pattern: proxy returns 204 early-close in the middle of keepalive window, client treats as ICE and reconnects. sample: 
```
[2026-03-21T10:11:57Z] proxy=gw-12 session=sess-9 event=resp code=204 body=empty
[2026-03-21T10:11:58Z] ws-close session=sess-9 reason=remote_close
[2026-03-21T10:11:58Z] client-reconnect session=sess-9 attempt=1
```
Marta Kowalski: Interesting. We rolled a proxy change at 10:05 to prefer keepalive-ttl=45s on low-memory nodes. Could that produce mid-stream 204s when connection is drained?
Alex Chen: tracer-bot, show routing trace for one affected session.
tracer-bot: trace https://console.internal/traces/1800012345-abc (internal) -> shows proxy drain hook sending 204 with no session-tag; sticky-lease remains but proxy returns EOF.
Priya Nair: Telemetry gap: probe-origin tag missing in some traces so console groups those sessions under "unknown" tenant row. Hard to filter by canary or config.
Jamal Ortiz: Billing oddity: some resume flows show no immediate quota debit but later emit duplicate billing events on reconnects. likely resume path re-entrant handling.
Marta Kowalski: UX ask: can we add proxy-drain_reason and keepalive-ttl columns to session table? also a small panel to link 204 spikes to node drain ops.
Alex Chen: Ops immediate mitigation: revert keepalive-ttl change on the low-memory pool or mark those nodes 'no-streams'. Priya, can you coordinate?
Priya Nair: Pushing revert now. INF ticket created INF-2001. Adding temporary alert: proxy-204-rate > baseline*3 -> page.
infra-bot: deploy "revert-proxy-keepalive-ttl" started at 10:28 UTC by Priya N.
Jamal Ortiz: Also adding a guard in resume handler: idempotency token check to prevent double-bill on session rejoin. Will PR after ops stable.
Marta Kowalski: Good. For console, short-term workaround: expose trace link in the session row and allow filter by response-code. I'll file a UI backlog card.
Alex Chen: Post-mortem follow-ups: 1) test for proxy-drain 204 behavior in e2e harness, 2) routing sim add scenario where proxy returns 204 mid-ttl, 3) billing unit test for resume dedupe.
Priya Nair: Revert completed at 10:34 UTC, reconnect rate back to baseline by 10:36. Noted two tenants who spiked more than others; reached out to CSMs.
tracer-bot: canary-check -> no canary rollout during window. change was infra-level.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll open PR for resume dedupe (ETA today). Adding a meter assertion to ensure single billing event per resume request.
Marta Kowalski: I'll draft the postmortem, include screenshots of 204 spike and console UX suggestions, and put the UI card in the backlog.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. One last ask: add a console heatmap for proxy-204 by node id so SRE can correlate with drains quickly next time.
Priya Nair: Filed dashboard task DD-402 and assigned to eng-sre.
Jamal Ortiz: Closing my loop, will link PR to INF-2001.
Marta Kowalski: Will post the runbook entry "proxy drain -> websocket behavior" once drafts are ready.
Alex Chen: Great hustle, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
